section.title: Downloading a member's week of workouts
section.scenario: A gym's member app keeps each member's workout log. Before a session, a coach downloads one member's past week of workouts and opens the file in a spreadsheet. This download is the only export the app offers.
section.question: The coach's request was a file that opens in a spreadsheet, and that is the whole request. Which piece should build the download, and which stated fact decides it?
